LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS: CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions: Correlative Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions: Correlative Conjunctions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we join sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify correlative conjunctions in texts
2. use correlative conjunctions in sentences
3. appreciate use of correlative conjunctions for effective communication
